provenance: Invented, sanitized conditions created because the supplied work contained no original product screenshots. These are not observations or measurements of the motivating private product.
evaluationNote: Expected findings and must-not-report guards are review criteria, not measured agent results. Structural tests verify benchmark coverage only; a model comparison must record misses, false positives, source evidence, and whether rendered output was inspected.

visual.condition: A rounded selected card has top and side borders but its bottom stroke disappears.
expected: BORDLINE partial or clipped border candidate; inspect computed sides and rendered edge
mustNotReport: A deliberate one-sided accent rule without a rounded surface

visual.condition: Repeated panels use 1px, 3px, and 4px strokes without a state or role difference.
expected: Repeated component stroke variance with the affected elements and measured widths
mustNotReport: A documented severity edge with one owner

visual.condition: A selected tab keeps its border underline and adds a second pseudo-element underline on hover.
expected: Duplicate active and hover indicator layers on the same edge
mustNotReport: A hover background that does not duplicate the selected indicator

visual.condition: A keyboard focus outline extends outside a toolbar that clips overflow.
expected: Focus indicator clipped by the toolbar; identify both element and clipping ancestor
mustNotReport: A scroll viewport that intentionally clips off-screen content while leaving focus visible

visual.condition: A stepper connector sits visibly below the centers of its adjacent circular steps.
expected: Connector alignment candidate with offset from both node centers
mustNotReport: A connector intentionally attached to a different anchor point

visual.condition: The same option panel changes padding and radius across equivalent variants without a functional reason.
expected: Repeated component geometry variance; investigate the shared component or token
mustNotReport: A distinct selected or disabled variant with a stated contract

necessity.condition: A 'Two teams' label sits above two clearly named team rows.
expected: REMOVE or MERGE the repeated count if it adds no decision value
mustNotReport: Removing the team names or necessary roster context

necessity.condition: A permanent 'Live connection' pill is shown while every participant is connected.
expected: CONDITIONAL DISPLAY; keep meaningful loss and recovery status
mustNotReport: Removing an actionable disconnected or reconnecting indicator

necessity.condition: The navigation item and page heading both say 'Lobby' without adding orientation.
expected: REMOVE or REWRITE one duplicate heading after checking navigation context
mustNotReport: Removing the only page title or accessible landmark name

necessity.condition: A permanent instruction card repeats the adjacent host instructions and has no first-use behavior.
expected: RELOCATE, REWRITE, or conditionally show the instruction at the relevant step
mustNotReport: Removing essential instructions from first use or recovery

necessity.condition: A decorative separator divides a short two-item setup with no grouping purpose.
expected: REMOVE if the rule communicates no grouping or scanning relationship
mustNotReport: Removing a separator that communicates hierarchy in a dense expert view

necessity.condition: A disabled selector asks users to choose the only available game mode.
expected: REMOVE the false choice or replace it with an accurate fixed fact
mustNotReport: Removing a genuine preference or a setting required by product policy

composition.condition: A help page centers every section in a narrow column, leaving its category navigation disconnected from the task.
expected: Diagnose whole-screen relationship and first-viewport hierarchy before local spacing edits
mustNotReport: A centered layout solely because another alignment is stylistically preferred

composition.condition: A game setup gives three controls equal visual weight and hides the single start action below them.
expected: Identify setup hierarchy and action placement from the game-start task
mustNotReport: Adding extra cards, badges, or steps to make the setup look fuller

composition.condition: The live question and answer controls are a small grid cell below four larger status and promotion cards.
expected: Restore the gameplay instrument and primary action as the screen's focal point
mustNotReport: Removing player context needed to play or recover

composition.condition: Choose file, map columns, and review import appear as distant equal boxes with no directional relationship.
expected: Connect the import stages into one understandable progression and preserve backtracking
mustNotReport: A forced wizard when the product supports useful direct editing

composition.condition: Equivalent team panels have a 2:1 width ratio without different content or action needs.
expected: Correct unjustified spatial imbalance while keeping team identity and live counts visible
mustNotReport: Equalizing panels solely for symmetry when their content demands different space

microcopy.condition: The prompt 'Already have a template?' precedes an importer that accepts general CSV, XLSX, and JSON files.
expected: Rewrite the prompt to name supported files or sources accurately
mustNotReport: Removing an import format or inventing a template requirement

microcopy.condition: A board-size field is labeled '26 playable letters' with no explanation of the choice.
expected: Explain the selectable board or alphabet behavior in terms of the user's decision
mustNotReport: Shortening the text if that would erase a real constraint

microcopy.condition: An answer-order control uses 'FIRST IN' and 'NEXT' without a visible referent.
expected: Replace vague labels with explicit answer-order actions or outcomes
mustNotReport: Changing established domain wording without checking the product mechanic

microcopy.condition: Ordinary input validation exposes ERR_204 and an internal payload path.
expected: State the user-facing problem and correction; retain identifiers only in diagnostics when useful
mustNotReport: Removing technical details from a support or administrator diagnostic surface

microcopy.condition: Pricing copy repeats 'fast' four times and restates monthly renewal without clarifying terms.
expected: Remove redundant phrasing while preserving price, cadence, renewal, and cancellation meaning
mustNotReport: Changing legal or billing precision in the name of brevity

state.condition: A player-count error is visible before the host tries to continue.
expected: Show the validation after the relevant action unless a real precondition must be stated earlier
mustNotReport: Hiding an important safety or eligibility constraint

state.condition: A room-code error remains after a valid four-letter code is entered.
expected: Clear the error and invalid state when the cause is corrected
mustNotReport: Clearing an unrelated warning that remains true

state.condition: The UI announces 'Saved' while the save request is still marked busy.
expected: Keep progress visible until the mutation succeeds; announce success only after completion
mustNotReport: A truthful optimistic state with rollback and clear pending language

state.condition: An empty question bank exposes sorting and team filters that cannot change any result.
expected: Hide irrelevant controls and surface the next meaningful empty-state action
mustNotReport: Removing import or recovery actions needed to leave the empty state

state.condition: A healthy connection pill occupies permanent space while all players are connected.
expected: Keep healthy state quiet and reveal status when a connection changes or recovery is needed
mustNotReport: Removing meaningful disconnected, permission, or reconnecting status

crossRoute.condition: The same language selector is a pill, a bordered field, and a custom control on adjacent routes.
expected: Inventory the shared pattern and trace differences to its owning component or local override
mustNotReport: Forcing public, dashboard, and editor page compositions to match

crossRoute.condition: Equivalent selected tabs use filled pill, underline, and unmarked text treatments across routes.
expected: Unify the shared selected-state contract or explain a real contextual difference
mustNotReport: Treating distinct navigation jobs as equivalent solely by label

crossRoute.condition: The same primary action is a square filled button on one route and an unrelated purple pill on another.
expected: Trace the style to a shared component, token, or intentional action role and repair the owner
mustNotReport: Removing a justified action distinction that changes meaning

crossRoute.condition: Adjacent routes express the same invalid-code condition as a banner and unrelated inline text.
expected: Compare trigger, recovery, and shared validation pattern before aligning presentation
mustNotReport: Forcing error placement to match when field relationships differ

acceptance.condition: Automated interaction tests pass, but the rendered keyboard focus ring is cut by overflow hidden.
expected: Reject the visual state and capture the affected element with its clipping ancestor
mustNotReport: Claiming rendered quality from tests or source inspection alone

acceptance.condition: The desktop view fits, but three fixed-width workflow columns are cut off on a narrow phone.
expected: Compare the core task at desktop and phone widths; report the phone failure
mustNotReport: Treating desktop capture as responsive verification

acceptance.condition: English form labels fit, but Arabic RTL text is left-aligned and its mixed-script code is reversed.
expected: Inspect RTL direction, alignment, ordering, and mixed-script isolation in rendered output
mustNotReport: Treating Arabic support as verified from an English screenshot

acceptance.condition: Initial join is usable, but the validation state exposes an internal code and invalid field without recovery text.
expected: Capture and review the error state as well as initial state; reject the missing recovery guidance
mustNotReport: Accepting the page because its initial state passed

acceptance.condition: A decorative redesign adds a large gradient hero and moves the join action below secondary content.
expected: Reject the reduced task visibility even if the new treatment is more decorative
mustNotReport: Assuming more decoration or a larger diff means an improvement

positiveControls.condition: A deliberately asymmetric field-notes screen gives the observation list and current site different widths for clear task reasons.
expected: KEEP the composition; verify the primary observation action remains visible
mustNotReport: Equalizing columns only for symmetry

positiveControls.condition: A dense dispatch table exposes many operational rows and labeled columns to trained staff.
expected: KEEP useful expert density and verify target size, hierarchy, and scan order
mustNotReport: Removing useful fields to make the interface sparse

positiveControls.condition: Ending a live game requires confirmation because it removes the current round for every player.
expected: KEEP a clear consequence and a safe cancel action
mustNotReport: Removing the safeguard as redundant friction

positiveControls.condition: A disconnected state persistently says the connection is lost and offers retry.
expected: KEEP the status and recovery action until connectivity is restored
mustNotReport: Hiding a material state because status pills are often redundant

positiveControls.condition: A one-sided accent edge on a square callout identifies the active host instruction and has no duplicate indicator.
expected: KEEP the intentional asymmetric treatment when it is legible in rendered output
mustNotReport: Classifying every one-sided edge as a broken border

positiveControls.condition: A restrained join page shows one labeled room-code field and one direct join action.
expected: KEEP the focused page when the task is immediately clear
mustNotReport: Adding onboarding cards, decorative panels, or alternate paths without a user need

positiveControls.condition: A high-quality receipt upload page has a clear size constraint and one file action.
expected: No redesign; state what was inspected and any remaining evidence gap
mustNotReport: Inventing a visual defect or redesign task
